plan.title: [framework-gap] xbrief:preflight does not resolve file:// planRef that xbrief:validate accepts

narratives.Description: `xbrief:validate` strips a `file://` scheme from `plan.planRef` before it resolves the parent, but the parent-lineage check that `xbrief:preflight` runs does not, so a planRef such as `file://proposed/<epic>.xbrief.json` validates cleanly and then fails preflight with `parent not found at <repo>/xbrief/file:/proposed/...` (#6925). This story moves the scheme strip into one shared helper in `vbrief-validate/paths.ts` and has the parent-lineage resolver use it, keeping its exact-path, absolute-path and traversal rules unchanged.
narratives.Overview:
- Given a story whose `plan.planRef` is `file://proposed/<epic>.xbrief.json` and that epic exists, when `xbrief:preflight` runs the parent-lineage check, then it loads the epic from `<lifecycle root>/proposed/` and does not report `parent not found`.
- Given a `plan.planRef` of `file://xbrief/proposed/<epic>.xbrief.json`, when the parent-lineage check resolves it, then it returns the same path as the planRef without the scheme.
- Given a `plan.planRef` of `file:///<absolute path>` or `file://../<epic>.xbrief.json`, when the parent-lineage check resolves it, then it still refuses with the absolute-path or parent-traversal error.
- Given a `plan.planRef` without a scheme, when the parent-lineage check resolves it, then the result is unchanged from today.
- `xbrief:validate` and the parent-lineage check strip the `file://` scheme through one shared helper in `vbrief-validate/paths.ts`.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer who links stories to an epic with a `file://` planRef, I want `xbrief:preflight` to resolve the same planRef forms that `xbrief:validate` accepts, so that stories that pass validate and swarm:readiness do not all fail preflight at dispatch time.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/paths.ts: add an exported `stripFileScheme(uri)` helper and use it in `resolveRefPath` and `scopeIdsForRefUri` in place of the inline `file://` slices.
2. packages/core/src/scope/parent-lineage.ts: `resolveParentPathFromRef` strips the scheme with `stripFileScheme` before its absolute, traversal and leading `xbrief/` checks; the plan-reference branch of `resolveParentRefFromChild` uses the same helper.
3. Tests: packages/core/src/scope/parent-lineage.test.ts covers a `file://proposed/` planRef that loads the parent, a `file://xbrief/proposed/` planRef, `file:///abs` and `file://../x` refusals, and an unchanged scheme-less planRef; packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/paths.test.ts covers `stripFileScheme` and `resolveRefPath`.
4. One changelog.d fragment; verify with the vitest commands in verify_commands.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary
`xbrief:preflight` and `xbrief:validate` resolve `plan.planRef` differently, so a planRef that validates cleanly fails preflight.

## Context
A story xBRIEF links to its epic with `"planRef": "file://proposed/2026-11-21-1840-desk-p1-epic.xbrief.json"`. `deft xbrief:validate` (`vbrief-validate/epic-links.js` → `resolveRefPath`) strips `file://` and resolves relative to the lifecycle root, so D4 passes.

## Expected behavior
`deft xbrief:preflight -- xbrief/active/<story>.xbrief.json` accepts the same planRef forms that `xbrief:validate` accepts (or validate rejects the forms preflight cannot resolve).

## Actual behavior / gap
Preflight's parent-lineage check does not strip the scheme and fails closed:

`parent not found at <repo>/xbrief/file:/proposed/2026-11-21-1840-desk-p1-epic.xbrief.json ... [defect_class=child_spec]`

So all 12 activated stories in a cohort passed validate and swarm:readiness, then every one failed preflight at dispatch time. Workaround: write planRef without the scheme (`proposed/<epic>.xbrief.json`).

## Session notes
Suggest one shared planRef resolver for validate, readiness and preflight, and a validate warning when a form is not preflight-resolvable.

---
_Filed from a consumer session (deftai/evolution, runtime @deftai/directive-runtime 0.129.13, launcher @deftai/directive 0.129.14). Refs #1709_

expected_outputs: stripFileScheme helper in vbrief-validate/paths.ts used by resolveRefPath, scopeIdsForRefUri and the parent-lineage resolver
xbrief:preflight parent lineage resolves file:// planRefs the way xbrief:validate does; absolute and traversal refusals unchanged
